target_rule: a plan row proposes corpus_home / (the source file's own path BELOW its declared kind folder), with the suffix the conversion stage writes (.md). A topic is never decided by an engine: the proposed path inherits the source's OWN arrangement and the owner may move a row's folder

decisions_declared.already_in_the_corpus: a file whose DOOR KEY the corpus home already holds: the pipeline has the work and there is nothing to admit
decisions_declared.seen_by_an_ingest_record: a file only the S0.5 metadata cache names, because the corpus file now carries a different key (MEASURED 2026-10-16: the corpus itself was renamed under T-130). The pipeline READ the work, so it is SEEN and not a candidate - printed because a second voice saying 'seen' is not the same voice as the corpus saying it
decisions_declared.admit_candidate: a file whose key neither the corpus nor an ingest record names, in a container the conversion stage accepts, inside its declared kind folder, under a root that declares a corpus home, carrying a name NO defect pattern matches: THE OWNER'S WORKLIST
decisions_declared.refused_no_declared_corpus_home: its root declares admits_to: null, so NO declaration names a home its works are admitted to: the refusal names the missing declaration instead of inventing a destination (T-181 limb 2)
decisions_declared.refused_container_no_stage_reads_it: a container the conversion stage cannot read (declared kinds such as .mobi/.azw3/.djvu/.docx are OWNED but not convertible): admitting one needs an ENGINE, which is T-180's misplaced class and not this reader's act
decisions_declared.refused_container_corrupt: a container of an ACCEPTED kind whose own BYTES are not openable (a truncated download, a file renamed to a suffix it is not): the stage reads this kind, so the remedy is not an engine but a RE-DOWNLOAD of the work. It is its own class because it is its own remedy - folding it into the engine class would let one act answer for two blast radii (BUG-886, MEASURED 2026-10-17: 3 of 1,289 library containers read as ordinary candidates)
decisions_declared.refused_name_repair_first: a name a declared defect pattern matches (marker/spine/truncation): an admitted file's name becomes the CORPUS NAME and the DOOR KEY, so admitting a defect materialises it into the tree the S0.5 cache then STAMPS. The repair rides FIRST - T-176, the owner's rename plan, whose eligible rows are exactly this class
decisions_declared.refused_not_in_its_kind_folder: the file does not sit under its declared kind folder (the placement axis, axis_depth 1), so the path its corpus twin would take cannot be derived: the misplaced class T-180 owns
decisions_declared.refused_domain_not_a_corpus_domain: the file does not sit under a folder this root declared as its axis, or that folder is not a name the CORPUS already materialises (arrangement.share_rule): admitting it would put a new top-level name in the one corpus home and silently widen the domain vocabulary the pipeline classifies against, so the row is refused and counted instead (D-3062)
